properties.name: BL-124: exclude review records from the design network. An acknowledgement Decision is wired GOVERNED_BY into everything it acknowledges, so it joined the island it acknowledged and made disconnected_community permanently unclosable. Fixed at design_network() rather than at the defect-id hash because it has three consumers. MEASURED on reflow2's own graph: 125 review records carrying 610 edges; four of the eight most central nodes were acknowledgements and are now none, with real components rising (rel:v0170 +75%, cmp:detect +41%); and surprising_connections went 16 to 32 — the bookkeeping edges were SUPPRESSING half the real surprises by tying communities together, which is the opposite of the predicted pollution.
